title: Approval provider coexistence
description: Arbiter replaces the official Auto Review; other plugins are reported through observable capability hints, and no plugin is disabled automatically.

detection.complete: The readable public interfaces are complete; the conclusion is based on this run's state.
detection.partial: Some public interfaces are unavailable ({surfaces}); only observed conflicts are reported.

reason.officialRunning: The official Auto Review ({source}) is actually running, so Arbiter will not take over any new session.
reason.autoSlotTaken: The Auto slot is already held by another provider ({source}): {error}
reason.approvalHook: {source} registered {capability}, which may affect approval outcomes.

none: No approval provider that might conflict was detected.
blockedGuidance: Turn off the official Auto Review ({source}) in plugin management and confirm it has stopped running, then reload this page and enable the session.
warningGuidance: The following items are informational only: Arbiter keeps reviewing in the current mode, and existing gates and other host guards stay unchanged.

notice.blockingBody: The official Auto Review ({source}) was detected running, so no new session is taken over and no permission was expanded.
notice.blockingGuidance: How to turn it off: click "Open plugin management" below, disable the official Auto Review plugin and confirm its running state becomes not running; then reload this page and enable the session. Settings, rule tests, history and diagnostics stay available.
notice.warningBody: {source} registered {capability}; Arbiter keeps reviewing in the current mode.
notice.detectionOnly: Only observed conflicts are shown; when some interfaces are unavailable the full state cannot be confirmed.

autoSlotProblem.failed: Auto slot registration failed, so Arbiter did not take over that entry: {error}. Reload this plugin and confirm the state again.
autoSlotProblem.unavailable: This host does not provide an Auto slot, so Arbiter cannot take over at that entry.
